title: ECP Registration Gate State (M3-RG0 authoritative trust instrument)
description: The AUTHORITATIVE registration-gate document of a protected evaluation + registration trust store (M3-RG0, 0.7.0, order §10 / ADJ-06 hard precondition). It lives in the authoritative zone (authoritative/gate.json) and states, machine-checkably: registration OPEN/CLOSED, model execution OPEN/CLOSED, scientific results NONE/PRESENT, and the six Owner-bound operational citations (O-01/O-02/O-04/F-01a/F-01b/POP) in force — null while unresolved, frozen to the owner-gate-order values once an order opens the gate. The ONLY legal mutation path is apply_owner_gate_order (an explicit owner instrument recorded as a lineage gate-transition event); there is no other writer. gate_hash = SHA-256 over the ECP-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0 serialization of this document with gate_hash removed (the established self-referential exclusion rule; never hash the populated field). Real gate material lives only in a private trust area; public illustrations under examples/ must be format-illustration records with real recomputable hashes.

content_class.description: 'review' = real gate material (private trust area only); 'format-illustration' = public dummy (examples/ only).

scope.description: A development-scope order can never govern an operational-scope trust store and vice versa (scope binding).

transition_rule.description: Gate transitions ONLY via an explicit owner-gate-order instrument applied through the governed seam and recorded as a lineage gate-transition event; no other writer exists.

O-01.description: External novelty-evidence slot; null = unresolved (never inferred).

O-04.description: Protected ground-truth ruling slot (six sub-fields); null = unresolved.

F-01a.description: Set-level preregistration timing slot; null = unresolved.

F-01b.description: Case ordering rule slot; null = unresolved.
